data.description: The Biofuel Generator, or bio generator, is a big pot that turns food and other organic matter into low grade fuel, not power: it actually uses 5 rW. Load its 3 input slots and it makes up to 5 fuel a minute, needing a 10-second stir every 30 minutes at full load. Craft it at a tier 1 workbench for 250 frags and 150 wood, 40 [scrap](/items/scrap) to research or 5 [blueprint fragments](/items/blueprint-fragment) through the tech tree.
data.name: Biofuel Generator
